name: LiveAgent
description: LiveAgent is a help desk and customer support software combining live chat, ticketing, and call center features into one platform.

evidence.claim: LiveAgent provides complete API v3 documentation and Python client SDK on GitHub.
API keys are generated in admin configuration under Configuration > System > API and passed via the 'apikey' header.
LiveAgent combines AI chatbot, live chat, ticketing & call center with a free start tier option.

notes: LiveAgent provides API v1 (deprecated) and API v3 (active with continuous enhancements) utilizing API key authentication passed via request headers.
